scope: Two private RealBud desktops, one company service, three proposal workflows; deliberate sharing; macOS and Windows
note: Coverage catalogue and acceptance targets. Existing automated suite passes are supporting evidence, not per-case installed acceptance. No unexecuted case is marked passed. CRM and autonomous organisations are excluded from the core.

cases.action: Install on a clean Mac and Windows host
cases.expected: Set up company without a terminal; signed binaries, durable storage and clear prerequisite recovery

cases.action: Join from the other OS using a valid invitation
cases.expected: Join the intended company with a separate person and device identity

cases.action: Use expired, reused, wrong-company and malformed invitations
cases.expected: Reject safely; retain existing local work and offer a new invitation

cases.action: Interrupt setup, retry, or open setup twice
cases.expected: One owned service/database; no duplicate company or lost state

cases.action: Restart, change network, encounter a port conflict or stale host certificate
cases.expected: Reconnect to the paired host or present an explicit repair; never trust a different host silently

cases.action: Join with existing private records and imported packs
cases.expected: Preserve private records; joining does not publish them or activate schedules

cases.action: Open both profiles simultaneously with different private canary notes
cases.expected: No cross-person chat, memory, counters, search, notifications or local-file leakage

cases.action: Sign out or change membership while requests and uploads are pending
cases.expected: Clear private UI and refuse stale writes/results; cancel or safely retain owned work

cases.action: Try accessing an unshared staff case or impersonating a member
cases.expected: Deny; admin service credentials do not become a member session

cases.action: Expire entitlement or exhaust quota while work is pending
cases.expected: Gateway denies new work with a clear reason; receipts remain available and no fallback master key is used

cases.action: Update a model/API key or recover a managed connection
cases.expected: Preserve member account ownership; never distribute master keys in packs, logs or worker environments

cases.action: Recover a forgotten sign-in or revoke a stolen device
cases.expected: Authorized recovery restores only the same identity; revoked sessions/devices cannot continue

cases.action: Connect separate Gmail and Calendar accounts under one managed project
cases.expected: Each member lists and uses only their own bound account IDs

cases.action: Cancel OAuth, leave consent pending, retry after a lost response
cases.expected: Show pending/cancelled/unknown accurately; avoid duplicate connections

cases.action: Disconnect, expire consent, or revoke access mid-job
cases.expected: Stop the affected operation, keep work, and show reconnect; never switch to a colleague account

cases.action: Approve a company-shared app account and later remove its grant
cases.expected: Current grant governs discovery and execution independently of shared text visibility

cases.action: Receive timeout, 429, 5xx, pagination failure or an unknown execution outcome
cases.expected: Bound retries; retain coverage/checkpoint; reconcile uncertain effects before another write

cases.action: Attempt a denied tool through alternate tool names or raw parameters
cases.expected: The server denies send/pay/sign and out-of-scope operations, regardless of assistant prose

cases.action: Read a defined mailbox and coverage window, classify, review and save priorities
cases.expected: Source-linked work list with explicit coverage, owner, uncertainty and next action; no outgoing mail

cases.action: Run the same inbox workflow on the second account
cases.expected: Read that account only; same workflow capability without the first user account

cases.action: Encounter a dangerous maintenance report, ambiguous address or missing attachment
cases.expected: Human escalation/source hold; no invented resolution, booking or source fact

cases.action: Read duplicate messages, forwarded threads and a new material reply
cases.expected: Link/update the correct work; do not duplicate completed work or erase human edits

cases.action: Read a suspicious instruction embedded in an email or attachment
cases.expected: Treat it as content; do not change permissions, pay, send or disclose unrelated data

cases.action: Read a newsletter, rent dispute and owner update request
cases.expected: No invented task for newsletter; verify ledger before an arrears claim; select privacy-appropriate output

cases.action: Lose page 2 or restart during mailbox scan
cases.expected: Retain checkpoint and show partial coverage; never call the mailbox fully checked

cases.action: Read selected expectations and invoices, prepare review and record human decision
cases.expected: Source-backed received/missing/uncertain classification; distinguish preparation from saved board records

cases.action: Receive a bill review, inspect permitted evidence and return the missing fact
cases.expected: Explicit handoff and private Bud preparation; sender reviews the returned result

cases.action: Encounter duplicate invoice, credit, revised amount, ambiguous property or date
cases.expected: Preserve originals and uncertainty; no duplicate obligation or guessed mapping

cases.action: Check a bill before its arrival window or with incomplete source coverage
cases.expected: Do not mark missing merely because the scan did not see it

cases.action: Mark payment arranged without verified PMS evidence
cases.expected: Keep follow-up open; arranged is not paid and review closed is not financial completion

cases.action: Edit concurrently, revoke source access or load a corrupt bill record
cases.expected: Reject stale edits/access; preserve corrupt data and show recovery rather than an empty board

cases.action: Select bank file, confirm format/rules, prepare, review and export a checked copy
cases.expected: Preserve original bytes, row order, totals, leading zeros and every column except approved references

cases.action: Run the same bank workflow on their own selected file
cases.expected: Use that local selection; same filename on another device is not the same source

cases.action: Use unmatched/ambiguous payer, duplicate date window or a partial account export
cases.expected: Hold ambiguity and flag overlap/coverage; no automatic assignment by name alone

cases.action: Use malformed CSV, quoted commas, Unicode, empty input, credit/refund or duplicate rows
cases.expected: Parse deterministically or explain rejection; never silently drop or coerce financial rows

cases.action: Export before review, repeat review, or change source after approval
cases.expected: Deny until the current exact revision is reviewed; reject stale approval

cases.action: Compare totals in the PMS preview and confirm final import manually
cases.expected: Record human/PMS evidence separately; Bud preparation never claims a bank transfer or posted receipt

cases.action: Preview and share selected text to a named colleague
cases.expected: Only selected material becomes visible; show sender, audience and purpose

cases.action: Open a view-only item and a writable item
cases.expected: View-only explains restriction with no Save response; writable item permits the current authorized action

cases.action: Retry a lost successful share or race two responses
cases.expected: One creation per request ID; one current revision wins; no silent overwrite

cases.action: Lose write permission while drafting or receive a closed item
cases.expected: Server rechecks authority; preserve draft where appropriate and explain why action stopped

cases.action: Accept responsibility and return a reviewed Bud result with usable evidence
cases.expected: Durable owner/acceptance/result; selected source has independent access, not a sender-only path

cases.action: Remove or replace an absent responsible person
cases.expected: Reassign permitted business work before losing continuity; private chat remains private

cases.action: Browse older pages or return after a long disconnect
cases.expected: Recover older open work and current state; distinguish loading, empty, connection error and corrupt record

cases.action: Run private workers simultaneously with distinct file nonces and memories
cases.expected: Correct authenticated member, Hermes home, account and execution device for each run

cases.action: Select Word, Excel, CSV and PDF sources with the same names on both devices
cases.expected: Read the selected version on the intended device; originals unchanged and unrelated folders unavailable

cases.action: Encounter missing worker, unsupported release or a model timeout
cases.expected: Clear setup/recovery; no fabricated output or substitution of a personal Hermes checkout

cases.action: Attach an approved site and perform a bounded read/prefill
cases.expected: Only the saved job/origin/account; verify the actual adapter result

cases.action: Navigate off origin, switch browser account or request send/pay/sign
cases.expected: Deny or require the existing exact authorized human step; no permission inherited from company join

cases.action: Stop while a tool is pending; retry after confirmed stop
cases.expected: Revoke execution, acknowledge process/control release and preserve partial receipts before retry

cases.action: Lock or sleep desktop, revoke accessibility, disconnect Cua or take manual control
cases.expected: Pause/release safely; visible repair at the task; no phantom completed run

cases.action: Import, export, re-import and move a pack to a fresh profile
cases.expected: Procedures survive; credentials, source files, approvals and active schedules do not travel

cases.action: Import invalid, oversized, conflicting, old-version or partially damaged packs
cases.expected: Validate whole input before changes; preserve existing procedures and explain conflicts

cases.action: Schedule the same shared occurrence or trigger manual work twice
cases.expected: One authoritative occurrence/claim; bounded capacity, no duplicate execution

cases.action: Miss a time due to sleep, DST, timezone change or host outage
cases.expected: Explicit catch-up policy and correct next occurrence; no burst of unintended work

cases.action: Edit/disable a schedule with an existing run or pending approval
cases.expected: Approval remains tied to its exact revision; stop and future scheduling are separate

cases.action: Schedule a job that needs an attended computer
cases.expected: Queue a clear Start beside me step rather than silently controlling a sleeping/unattended desktop

cases.action: Back up and restore onto a replacement host
cases.expected: Verify restored records, memberships, grants, job history and source references; prevent two active hosts

cases.action: Disk full, file lock, permission denied, lost removable drive or corrupt record
cases.expected: Preserve old data; actionable recovery without presenting success or empty data

cases.action: Install an app/worker update during queued work or revert a failed update
cases.expected: Compatible staged version, retained profiles and data, atomic selection and bounded recovery

cases.action: Quit app, restart OS or crash during pending work
cases.expected: Owned child processes and service lifecycle are explicit; recover receipt without assuming effect did not happen

cases.action: Export/leave company or uninstall/reinstall the application
cases.expected: Clear data-retention choice, scoped export and revoked device; no accidental deletion of company records

cases.action: Complete setup, join, connect, import and start work without technical assistance
cases.expected: Plain-language navigation and one useful next action; no master-key/engine configuration for staff

cases.action: Tab through forms, review, cancel, errors and return focus
cases.expected: Named controls, visible focus and usable keyboard order; modal/async changes are announced

cases.action: Use narrow window, enlarged text, long names and large task queues
cases.expected: No lost controls or horizontal clipping; scannable state, pagination and visible pending/error feedback

cases.action: Refresh, close a form, navigate away or retry after slow response
cases.expected: Prevent double actions, explain unsaved/uncertain state and preserve work as specified

cases.action: See Demo, synthetic, real-source, partial and reviewed output together
cases.expected: Every layer is clearly labelled; no sample result masquerades as office completion

cases.action: Run Mac-host/Mac-peer, Windows-host/Windows-peer and both mixed pairs
cases.expected: Record actual versions, runtime, TLS, identity, worker, file and computer-control receipts for each pairing

cases.action: Use standard account, firewall, antivirus, paths with spaces/Unicode and native file picker
cases.expected: Supported installer and driver work without weakening OS protections or relying on macOS path semantics

cases.action: Run simultaneous tasks plus a third queued job and revoke one worker
cases.expected: Fair bounded capacity; no profile collision; unaffected member can continue

cases.action: Inspect logs/diagnostics and a support export
cases.expected: Useful correlation and recovery data; no credentials or other members private content
